name: cursors
title: Collaborative Cursors
author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
description: Real-time presence overlay with conflict-free position sync, idle detection, and a label overlap resolver that prevents names from stacking.
docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/cursors. Wrap your shared surface with CursorsRoot and CursorCanvas. CursorsRoot holds state and exposes the imperative update API. CursorCanvas is the tracking surface — it measures mouse position, normalizes it, and calls onMove. Use the useCursors hook to wire your transport with updateCursor and removeCursor.
